answer: Charge every identity a 50-unit bridge toll, doubling it for each extra identity from the same operator, so N clones cost 50 x (2^N - 1). A falcon audit re-checks one in ten per epoch; a clone caught sharing work forfeits its toll plus a 200-unit bond. A gale shuts the bridge for an epoch to identities with no bonded history, so late clones wait while the bill compounds.
